body_html:
Passed 2025-08-15. Reading generated by ollama:deepseek-v4-pro from the enrolled text; the full text is at the foot of this page so every statement can be checked against it. LegiScan record · official text

What it does

This law requires each community college board to ensure that a course is taught by an individual faculty member who meets specified qualifications. It prohibits a course from using artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction in place of a faculty member. It allows faculty members to use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction.

Who it applies to

  • Each board of a public community college district
  • Faculty members who teach courses at those colleges

Effective date

not stated in the text

Key definitions

  • artificial intelligence: has the same meaning given to the term in Section 2-101 of the Illinois Human Rights Act (Sec. 3-29.28(a))

Obligations

  • Each board shall require the faculty member who teaches a course to be an individual who meets the qualifications set forth in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and any other applicable rules adopted by the State Board (Sec. 3-29.28(b))

Prohibitions

  • A course may not, in lieu of a faculty member, use artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction for students (Sec. 3-29.28(b))

Penalties and enforcement

The statute does not state who enforces it, what penalties apply, or whether there is a private right of action.

How it affects AI deployment

  • A community college cannot deploy an artificial intelligence system as the sole source of instruction for a course in place of a qualified faculty member (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).
  • A community college may deploy artificial intelligence to augment course instruction by a faculty member (Sec. 3-29.28(c)).
  • A community college must ensure that any faculty member teaching a course meets the qualifications in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and any applicable State Board rules (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).

Notable exemptions

  • Nothing in this Section prohibits a faculty member from using artificial intelligence to augment course instruction (Sec. 3-29.28(c))

Compliance steps

  • Ensure each faculty member who teaches a course is an individual meeting the qualifications in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and any applicable State Board rules (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).
  • Prohibit any course from using artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction in lieu of a faculty member (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).
  • Allow faculty members to use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction (Sec. 3-29.28(c)).
